scenes.title: INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT
lines: Marcus stands over the desk flipping through old photographs.
I didn’t expect this to come back.

scenes.title: EXT. CHICAGO STREET - DAWN
lines: Elijah runs toward the bus stop. Streets glisten from rain.

scenes.title: INT. POLICE STATION - MORNING
lines: Detective Ramirez sips burnt coffee reviewing case files.
Marcus and Elijah — two names that won’t leave me alone.
